caption: The drawing depicts a rooster figurine mounted on a rectangular wooden base. The rooster's body is primarily colored in brown, with a red comb and wattle on its head. There is a green patch representing the wing on the side of the body. The tail feathers are large and rounded, featuring a graduated color pattern of brown, red, and light gray. The beak is small and dark, while the eye is black with a pale ring. The legs of the rooster are depicted as a single spiral metal spring attached to the wooden base, giving the appearance that the rooster is balanced on the spring. The background is a plain, beige color, and there is a signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Pa. German Toy Rooster with Bellows
